subject: Private fleet canary sprint — exit guidelines & schedule
messages:
From: eng@nimbusfin.com
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: datacenterops@colossusdc.com
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private fleet patch window question

Hi Chloe + team,

We are trying to align our maintenance calendar with your private deployment patch next week. Our security team prefers a short canary sprint rather than a full-wave window (2–4 hosts over 48 hours). Two quick asks: can you confirm the minimum blackout window for our workload, and whether Redwood can run a narrow canary with automatic fallback to the pinned model version?

Attached: fleet-inventory.csv (summary provided by our ops).

Thanks,
Adrian Kumar
Platform Engineer, NimbusFin
From: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
To: eng@nimbusfin.com; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: datacenterops@colossusdc.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private fleet patch window question

Adrian — thanks for the heads up. High level plan below; I attached a concise runbook and the network drain checklist for your infra team.

Summary (proposed):
- Canary sprint: 2 hosts in the primary VPC for 6 hours (traffic ramp 0 -> 20% -> 50% -> hold).
- Pin policy: target nodes run the new version but we keep a pinned fallback image on standby; requests route to pinned model if latency or error rates cross thresholds.
- Minimum blackout: none expected if we do graceful KV cache drain; expect transient 1–2% error spike during codec warmup which we can mitigate with a brief traffic hold.
- Rollback: automated unpin + drain reversal; manual network circuit break if cleanup fails.

Next steps / action owners:
- NimbusFin: confirm host list and scheduled 6-hour window (Adrian).
- DatacenterOps: run network-drain-checklist during week-of (Colossus ops).
- Redwood infra: I will run the canary and monitor metrics; Karthik will own failover scripting.

I recommend the window Thu 2026-05-06 02:00–08:00 UTC (local off-peak). If we need a different slot, say so and we'll adjust.

Chloe Martin
Sr. Manager, Private Deployments | Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai; eng@nimbusfin.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private fleet patch window question

Quick technical notes to add:
- KV/cache drain: we will evict active KV for canaried pods and warm the new containers with a small token preload. Expect ~30s warmup per process; we’ll stagger to avoid thundering.
- Prefix caching: we’ll enable prefix cache forward for the 2 canary hosts to reduce cold-start hits on embeddings and completions.
- Fallback path: when error_rate > 1.5% OR p95 latency > 600ms for 10m, route traffic back to pinned model variant for the affected tenant. These are configurable during the run.
- Telemetry: ensure NimbusFin exposes request-id header so we can correlate traces.

Attachments: canary_runbook.pdf (includes gating scripts).

Karthik
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai; eng@nimbusfin.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private fleet patch window question

Thanks — adding the operational gating checklist and abort criteria:
- Gating: successful healthcheck, no instance crashloop, OOMs = 0, error_rate < 1.5% at 5m, token spend within expected band.
- Abort criteria (immediate rollback): sustained p50 latency increase > 2x for 15m OR increased 5xx rate for the canary cohort by > 3x.
- Emergency unpin: sequence is (1) pause traffic to canary hosts, (2) reassign routing to pinned variant, (3) run a fast KV resync to pinned nodes, (4) mark incident and open a postmortem ticket.

I will run the telemetry dashboard during the sprint and call the abort if we hit the thresholds. If we need a hard stop, contact me on the bridge.

– Soojin
Director, Reliability Ops
From: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
To: eng@nimbusfin.com; soojin_lee@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai; neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: datacenterops@colossusdc.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private fleet patch window question

Perfect — thanks everyone. Adrian (NimbusFin): confirmed window Thu 2026-05-06 02:00–08:00 UTC, host list received.

Final checklist for the run:
- Chloe: kick the canary at 02:00 UTC and monitor first 90 minutes at steady 20% traffic.
- Karthik: deploy gating scripts and validate the fallback routing pre-window (by Wed EOD).
- Soojin: watch telemetry and execute abort sequence if thresholds exceed.
- Colossus DC: perform network drain and validate ACLs (use network-drain-checklist.xlsx).

Post-run: 24-hour smoke window where we keep pinned fallback available for quick resurrection. Please confirm you've got the runbook link and the attachments. If no objections, I'll send a formal calendar invite with the bridge and doc links.

Chloe
